name: BEANS: The Benchmark of Animal Sounds
description: A benchmark of 12 bioacoustic classification and detection datasets spanning animal groups including birds, land and marine mammals, anurans, and insects.
citation: Hagiwara, M., Hoffman, B., Liu, J.-Y., Cusimano, M., Effenberger, F., & Zacarian, K. (2022). BEANS: The Benchmark of Animal Sounds. arXiv:2210.12300.
